verdict.rationale: CrewAI Flows are explicitly documented as event-driven workflows that connect tasks, manage state, and control execution flow, and Crews support sequential/hierarchical process graphs — this covers structured composition and some branching. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents loop constructs or parallel step execution within Flows/Crews, only sequential/hierarchical dichotomy and generic 'control flow of execution' language. missing for 10: explicit documentation of loop constructs, explicit documentation of parallel/concurrent step execution, independent hands-on confirmation of branching/loops working as advertised.
